VA patent finder

SearchMedical centersTechnologyCharts

Every U.S. patent and published application whose USPTO ownership records list the Department of Veterans Affairs as an owner: 1,762 records, 738 of them in force. Search the titles and abstracts, narrow by technology, medical center, owner or status, and open any record for its sources. It shows who owns each record on the USPTO record, not whether a patent can be licensed.

click a year; shift-click for a range

Technology areas are grouped from each record's CPC classification codes. Status and citation counts are as Google Patents shows them (read Nov 24, 2026).

Each VA medical center with records, and the organizations that most often own records with VA there. The inventors are not named.

Charts

The centers

The records by technology area, grouped from their CPC classification codes. Click an area to see its records.

The records in charts: what became of them, who owns them with VA, when VA's interest was recorded, and the approved drugs that list them. Hover for the numbers; Open large shows a chart on its own. Every chart is also on the Visuals page.

How the records sort

Each record once: how VA came onto the title, who owns it with VA, and its status as Google Patents shows it. Next walks through it in six steps; hover for counts. Owner kinds are grouped by words in the owners' names, so a few are approximate. Source: USPTO assignment records and Google Patents; the Search view lists every record.
